name: GAN i4 Leap Frosted 3x3 (Smart Cube)
description: The GAN i4 Leap Frosted 3x3 (Smart Cube) redefines the smartcube experience with cutting-edge hardware and elite customization. Perfect for serious speedcubers and data-driven solvers, the i4 Leap brings GAN’s flagship technology to your hands with a precision-engineered spring tensioning system and a refined frosted (matte) outer finish for effortless grip and stability.
features: Dual-Core Endurance: Switch between full-power Performance Mode or legendary 200-hour Endurance Mode to match your session and maximize battery life.
Ultra-Lightweight: Weighs just 74g, delivering an effortless, fatigue-free solving experience.
Advanced Customization: 72 flexible tuning combinations (6 travel gears x 12 tension gears) let you dial in your perfect feel in seconds, right out of the box.
Fast Charging: Quick 10-minute charge gives you up to 10 hours of wireless grinding when you’re on the go.
Omni-Support Engineering: Hollow design for minimized friction, stable omni-support spherical core, and magnetic GES for smooth, jam-free performance.
6-Color Ball Core: Simplifies reassembly and guarantees perfect sync with smart features and the companion app.
